faqs.question: What services does Tech Promotion BD provide?
faqs.answer: Tech Promotion BD provides 100% organic social media promotion services including Facebook video views, page/profile followers, likes, custom comments, and viral shares across Bangladesh. All campaigns are delivered through legitimate promotion networks compliant with social platform guidelines.

faqs.question: How do I place an order?
faqs.answer: Simply browse our packages (Entry, Core, Premium, or VIP), choose the package that fits your goals, click "Order Now", enter your name, WhatsApp number, client location, and your Facebook page or video link, and submit your payment TrxID via bKash, Nagad, or Rocket. Our Admin verifies the order and starts delivery.

faqs.question: How do I provide my Facebook/Instagram/YouTube link?
faqs.answer: In the order modal, paste your public URL (for example: https://www.facebook.com/yourpagename or your video link). Ensure that your account or video privacy is set to "Public" so our delivery systems can reach your content.

faqs.question: How can I pay?
faqs.answer: We accept payments through Bangladesh mobile banking including bKash, Nagad, and Rocket (Send Money personal). Send the amount to our provided numbers and enter your Transaction ID (TrxID) in the form.

faqs.question: Is payment and ordering secure?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100%. Payments are made directly to our official mobile banking accounts with your unique TrxID. We never ask for your passwords, and every order is assigned a verifiable Order Number that you can track live.

faqs.question: Can I increase the quantity?
faqs.answer: Yes! Packages that support quantity increases allow unlimited volume scaling. You can adjust the tier with + / - or enter any quantity, and the price will update dynamically in real time.

faqs.question: How long does service delivery take?
faqs.answer: Delivery typically starts within 15 to 60 minutes after payment confirmation. Depending on order volume, deliveries are organically dripped over hours to ensure maximum retention and account safety.

faqs.question: Can I order for multiple pages?
faqs.answer: Yes! Many of our packages explicitly support splitting across multiple pages or videos. You can provide additional links in the customer notes or share them directly with our WhatsApp team after checkout.

faqs.question: How can I contact support?
faqs.answer: Our dedicated customer support team is available 24/7 on WhatsApp at +8801601300122 and +8801795315431, or by emailing techpromotionbd@gmail.com. You can also click any "Contact on WhatsApp" button on this website for immediate assistance.
